category_edits.rationale: Remove the ranking margin across all four category models to test whether the prior mixed objective improves validation with the current untied normalized embeddings. Retain the 0.2 pointwise coefficient and existing nonpadding averaging; architecture, inference and training settings remain unchanged.

change_summary: Remove the 0.5 pairwise ranking margin while preserving the existing pointwise loss and nonpadding reduction. No predictor or checkpoint changes are required.
